BoardSetup.browser-agent-note: The server is set up for this agent, and it is the agent that works the column that tests.
BoardSetup.browser-column-note: The server is set up for this agent, and it is the agent that works the “{column}” column: a card that gets there is assigned to it and tested by it.
BoardSetup.browser-invalid: The browser server must be valid JSON: a server name mapped to its command and args, the same block any MCP client takes.
BoardSetup.browser-why: Testing is an agent clicking through a browser, which it gets from a browser MCP server. Without one a test session will not start; the configuration below usually fits.
BoardSetup.come-back: You can walk this again any time: the board’s ⋯ menu → “Walk the setup again…”.
BoardSetup.deploy-why: Where a card’s branch is published from the "Деплой" column. Skip it if nothing is deployed from here — everything else still works.

BoardSetup.folder-git: This board publishes a branch or waits for one, so its folder has to be a git repository. A board that does neither takes any folder.
BoardSetup.folder-why: An agent works in a folder on your machine. A card is matched to one by its folder field, which this fills in for you.

BoardSetup.source-why: A source puts cards on this board by itself — a notification from your phone, a script, a service. Records are sent to it over HTTP at the address the board is served on; from a phone that is the tailnet address.
